outcome: Infant admission to intensive care unit
finding: There was no significant difference in placental cyclophilin A expression between hypertensive and normotensive mothers.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in placental cyclophilin A expression between hypertensive and normotensive mothers, nor any difference in expression related to mode of delivery or perinatal outcomes.
gest_age: Full term (implied by "placenta submitted at full thickness")
